tarifsPage.title: Prices and times
tarifsPage.lead: For each service, a “from” price and the usual time your car stays with us. The exact price depends on your car: ask for a quote, it is free and comes with no obligation.

entretien.title: Change the oil before it turns into a breakdown
entretien.text: Oil change, filters, servicing to your manufacturer’s schedule, brake and fluid checks. We follow what the manufacturer recommends, no more and no less.

reparations.title: Clutch, timing belt: the price agreed before we take anything apart
reparations.text: A slipping pedal, a noise on start-up, a belt reaching its mileage. We diagnose, give you a detailed quote for parts and labour, and stick to it.

transparence.title: We show you the parts we replaced
transparence.text: You get your car back clean, the old parts if you want them, and an invoice that lists every line. If a repair can wait, we tell you that too.

infos.title: Finding the garage
infos.accessText: In the Blanche Tâche business park in Camon, a few minutes from Amiens. You can park right outside the workshop.
infos.mapTitle: Map to the Alliance Auto 80 garage, Camon

items.a: For an oil change or a service, it is best to book: call us or send a request and we will offer you a slot. For a noise, a warning light or a leak, call us and we will look at it as soon as we can.
Yes, free and with no obligation. If we find something else while working on the car, we call you before going any further.

items.q: How long will I be without my car?
items.a: An oil change takes about an hour, brake pads about the same. A clutch or a timing belt usually takes a day, depending on parts. We give you the time with the quote.

items.q: Do I keep the manufacturer’s warranty?
items.a: Yes. You can have a car under warranty serviced by an independent garage, as long as the manufacturer’s service schedule is followed with parts of matching quality. That is what we do.
By card or cash, when you collect your car. There is no online payment.
The garage is at 80 impasse Antoine Parmentier, in the Blanche Tâche business park in Camon. You can park right outside the workshop.
